name: Candlelit Scheme
desc: A candleholder carved from a pumpkin. Its design was deemed so cute that it was voted the worst horror movie prop ever. Ironically, after receiving this dubious "honor," the mass-produced "Candle-O'-Lantern" became one of the hottest party and home decorations among young people.
desc2: Equip to increase Armorer Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: How could a pumpkin this cute possibly scare anyone?!
